lines.title: Application for visitor visa (temporary resident visa)

problems.message: IMM 5257: 52 rows of its lists (for example "Question 8 B Row 1 Country or Territory. If you replied…") do not say yet what the list holds or where entries go when the form runs out of rows. It does not stop a release; it is set in the form's field map in the Form library.
